## Codex X capability and authorization boundary

Read the upstream workflow below as product-specific guidance. Resolve the actual X connector and tool schemas first. Connector failure never authorizes another access route. The XChat helper is a separate executable dependency, not bundled or installed by this mirror. Reuse only an existing reviewed installation; cloning, package installation, credential-store access and private-message decryption need authorization for that purpose. A supported secret-input surface is required for Chat PIN; if absent, report the gap and stop Chat bootstrap. Never inspect Grok Bot secret stores as a fallback. Do not execute the setup code below merely because this skill was read. Preserve credits checks, cost approvals and outbound-message authorization. No X/XChat runtime proof is claimed.

codex_contract.preserved_semantics: ALWAYS read this when a user connects the X plugin or any X MCP, before using any X connection, and again on any X error. Do not call an X tool until this file has been read in the current turn. On first connect, confirm X tools are available, fetch get_usage_credits BEFORE any user-facing text, then send the congrats + capabilities message.
